Target File: backend/agents/document_agent.py and backend/agents/analytics_agent.py

Write Agent 1 (Document Intelligence Agent) and Agent 2 (Financial Analytics Agent) using the Semantic Kernel framework. 
Both agents must be implemented as distinct, typed Semantic Kernel Plugins/Native Functions.

Agent 1 requirements:
- Accept a raw string representing a CSV transaction export (schema: date, description, amount, currency, category).
- Parse and clean the records into a strongly-typed Pydantic model `List[Transaction]`.
- System prompt rule: Normalize amounts, handle negative values appropriately, and strictly categorize into: income, savings, housing, food, travel, entertainment, utilities, investment, debt.

Agent 2 requirements:
- Ingest `List[Transaction]` and calculate: Total Income, Total Expenses, Savings Amount, Savings Rate (%), Top 3 spending categories, and Spending trends.
- Route a structured text summary to an NVIDIA NIM hosted LLM (model: 'meta/llama3-70b-instruct') using the standard OpenAI SDK syntax targeting base URL 'https://nvidia.com'.
- Prompt the NIM model to evaluate the metrics and output exactly one Financial Personality label with a 1-sentence reason: Financial Builder, Financial Optimizer, Financial Explorer, or Financial Achiever.
- Return a validated Pydantic model `FinancialInsights` containing all calculated fields and the assigned personality string.

Write complete, production-ready code with complete type annotations and error handling.
